findings.finding: Solid has an open $200M at-the-market program with Jefferies (424B5 dated 2026-08-06, on an effective automatic S-3ASR) and fully drew its previous $85M ATM, so it can sell stock into any bounce on 2026-09-25.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM on an effective S-3ASR can be drawn on any trading day, including 2026-09-25, with no further filing; the issuer has shown it uses such programs ($84,993,553 of $85M sold under the May 2025 supplement).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not separable from the tape: ATM sales are only disclosed in the next 10-Q. The 424B5/S-3ASR day itself (2026-08-06, alongside Q2 results) is not among the baseline's comparable falls.
findings.why_not_priced: The program is public since August and so its existence is priced; what the close does not hold is its use as a cap on a rebound — an issuer that drained its last ATM tends to sell into strength, so a bounce tomorrow would meet supply that a stock without a live ATM would not. If the market fully held this, low-volume drops in SLDB would not have a 47.5% up-rate and 0.0% median next day. Small because nothing says the agent is selling at 7.5 after a ~16% slide rather than waiting for strength.
findings.independence: The Q2 10-Q (2026-08-06) carries the same 'at-the-market' language per the baseline's EDGAR text probe; same issuer, not an independent source. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1707502/000119312526337935/sldb-20260630.htm
